title: Blackstone and Pimco target Gulf’s multibillion-dollar infrastructure investments
digest: Blackstone and Pimco announced increased investment in Gulf infrastructure, with Blackstone stating its annual investment in the region reached a historic high during a Bloomberg Invest Dubai panel on Thursday, November 12, 2026. Pimco highlighted digital infrastructure and transportation projects as funding opportunities. The move aligns with Gulf nations' efforts to diversify economies beyond oil, though specific financial commitments or project details remain un disclosed.
